en_how: Three.js builds a desk top with a dot-grid mat, a pen, a sticky note, a cup and floating UI cards (calendar, chat, music, map, to-do) painted onto CanvasTextures; a small original voxel figure carrying an envelope hops card to card along a keyed path every half second while the camera follows, then the camera pulls back to reveal the whole desk under a low warm sun with soft shadows.
